name: LATASHÁ
tagline: THE OCTAVE · onchain music pioneer · founder of Zoratopia & Topia
bio: Brooklyn-raised rapper, poet, visual and performance artist. Minting music-video works on Zora in 2021's first wave of onchain music; hired as Zora's head of community programming (June 2021); founded Zoratopia, the education platform and event series that carried artists — Black and independent creators first — into web3, from biweekly webinars to Art Basel Miami and NFT NYC. Today building Topia (topia.vision). Node 008: the octave, the return home.
quote: The evolution will not be televised. It will be onchain.
songs_note: Nothing appears on this node without LATASHÁ's blessing, item by item. This page is an invitation written from public sources only — the chair is held.
